{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/comments/7061825006","html_url":"https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486#issuecomment-7061825006","issue_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/486","id":7061825006,"node_id":"IC_kwDOU6rh8s8AAAABpOrl7g","user":{"login":"Jacob-J-Thomas","id":92639671,"node_id":"U_kgDOBYWRtw","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/92639671?u=9e8e1d135070c21655bc4d11866e64a1b5b85eb0&v=4","gravatar_id":"","url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas","html_url":"https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas","followers_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/followers","following_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/following{/other_user}","gists_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/gists{/gist_id}","starred_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/starred{/owner}{/repo}","subscriptions_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/subscriptions","organizations_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/orgs","repos_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/repos","events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/events{/privacy}","received_events_url":"https://api.github.com/users/Jacob-J-Thomas/received_events","type":"User","user_view_type":"public","site_admin":false},"created_at":"2026-11-21T11:20:24Z","updated_at":"2026-11-21T11:20:24Z","author_association":"OWNER","body":"# #486 written plan — revision 03 · 5/5 · critique-disposition.md

# Disposition of the independent Fable critique

The original Fable 5.2 xhigh report returned **REVISE PLAN** on revision 01. Its SHA-256 is `eaa1a59a8532b303d584377cbb7797c42b09a5c043d287bfc9637a66dfe31cdb`. Revision 02 incorporated the following coordinator-directed alternatives. Revision 03 amends S4’s evaluator boundary and S5’s optional literal on the evidence in the JSONata report. Actual Fable attempt 02 reached a usage limit before issuing a verdict. The targeted attempt 03 and a separate coordinator selection remain pending. [Original critique](../i4-486-fable-plan-critique-01/provider/provider-final-message.md) · [original proposal](../i4-486-architecture-01/README.md) · [revision 02](../i4-486-architecture-02/README.md) · [planning evidence](../i4-486-jsonata-contract-01/REPORT.md)

| Finding | Disposition and verifiable effect |
| --- | --- |
| R1 · harness callback collision | Accepted. Delete proposal for a new harness fallback/privacy policy. Preserve the full existing evidence fold, adapter text/code, no-handle D, H/U family/continuation conditions and pinned/safety precedence for domain exceptions and all lookalikes. The B17 pure canonical render is separated at source. Explicit per-site controls document existing raw text exposure. |
| R2 · resolver failure and missing-session recovery | Accepted. Unusable-uncertain guard precedes resolver. Missing-session construction follows a successful resolver; a restorable resolver failure preserves its original eligibility and prior informational provenance, then can reach the explicit fresh-session choice after repair. |
| R3 · terminal delivery catch | Accepted. Map only the local workspace-render/empty outcome. File-return uses the existing failure receipt path. Preserve unexpected error text, success-receipt append location and reconciliation behavior. |
| R4 · post-result provenance | Accepted only for winning B18/B19 faults. Add observed-result phase/fixed sentence; preserve conservative submission enum and suppress the contradictory generic suffix on that branch. No fabricated acceptance, generic provider/post-result policy change or new enum. |
| R5 · child link collisions | Accepted. Only a real failed-child wrapper uses the reserved top-level child keys. A succeeded child mapped by a failing parent links through the existing completion event and keeps independent recovery eligibility. |
| R6 · transform mappers, test and QA coverage | Accepted. Share hooks only, retain P01's existing text policy, add safe new inference mapper. Update both named child-retry tests while preserving independent dedup coverage. Require real filesystem, disk SQLite, script counter file and loopback HTTP counts; clearly label scripted providers. Exclude legacy and other established text contracts from new canary-absence rules. |
| S1 · nested inference duplication | Accepted. Drop the proposed child inference copy and wrapper recognizer change. Follow existing actual child links to the authoritative leaf failure at one and two levels. |
| S2 · canonical rerender ownership | Accepted. Engine-owned safe internal, existing pre-turn internal eligibility; window/fits, timeout, abort and real overflow remain their own paths. |
| S3 · exact retry re-emission | Accepted. Keep visit-log folding as-is. Regression traverses prior unreconciled retry → secondary temporary preparation failure without duplicated retry → restart → exact eligible retry. |
| S4 · evaluator helper signature | Accepted and narrowed for JSONata. Call only a concrete evaluator on prepared arguments. Its rejection identifies a call stage. Only local source branches or the established run-data field can justify the corresponding new fact. Preparation and predicate coercion retain their separate behavior. |
| S5 · static label and field ordinals | Revised on new evidence. Recommend fixed field/reason/direction for every new JSONata projection. Own enumerable replacements produced the same public domain projection as the built-in. A preparation getter threw before evaluation. A callback-thrown existing ExpressionError preserved identity and details. The public low-level input also permits JS values. A guarded literal would require a proven data-only source or another execution witness. The accepted ordinal policy remains JavaScript own enumerable key order. [Decision and alternative](expression-provenance.md) |
| S6 · workspace callers | Accepted. Keep template trim exactly where the engine now obtains the value, preserve sweep semantics, update the reference-sweep comment and all caller/override signatures and tests. |

## Exact amendments against revision 02

| Changed instruction | Evidence and effect |
| --- | --- |
| S4 concrete expression and predicate observation | S06/S11 separate preparation from evaluation. S10 separates the supplied error’s public identity from the origin of this invocation. Keep the same low-level rejection behavior, make observations local to one call, and keep predicate coercion distinct. The engine’s generic fixed reason may describe the failed authored field only on its established data-only call path. |
| S5 static expression labels | S02/S03 separate the direct AST/D3137 pair from built-in ownership. S04/S05/S07 distinguish effective binding semantics from identity. Pinned dependency input preprocessing also happens before root evaluation. Recommend withdrawing literal publication entirely, including the ordinary genuine built-in case, and omitting raw runtime code/position/argument from new JSONata public facts. The previous positive label assertion becomes an absence check. |
| Tests and affected files | Move the positive assertion to the exact field, correction, safe cause code and effect/recovery. Require preparation, passthrough, same-call/cross-call ownership, predicate coercion and release-surface controls. The prior 40-case contract validation is a historical source binding; implementation tests and independent QA must exercise the selected behavior. |
| Private logging | The new JSONata observer carries finite facts or an ordinary rejection for the existing path. It introduces no raw exception capture or log. General harness, terminal-receipt and other established diagnostics keep their current behavior. |

The package/engine inventory, B01–B26 dispositions, R1–R6, S1–S3, S5 ordinal choice and S6 are carried forward. Independent targeted recheck, a recorded delegated selection, implementation, behavior QA and formal delivery gates remain pending.
